name: STAR Assurance — CCSDS TM frame-decoder differential audit
summary: Differential audit of CCSDS TM transfer-frame decoders on a pinned corpus of valid and bit-flipped frames: field-exact decoding, silent acceptance of corrupted frames, disagreements; probe-validated.
reference: CCSDS 132.0-B-3 TM Space Data Link Protocol (frame layout) and CCSDS 131.0-B / 132.0-B FECF (CRC-16/CCITT, check value 0x29B1)
reference_observed: generator frames carry FECF with zero residue; a reference decoder written from the standard validates 12/12 and rejects exactly the bad-FECF frames; known-defect decoders (accept-all, MC-as-VC, OCF-in-data, broken driver) caught exactly

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-06: corpus generated in-repo with pinned sha256; drivers use documented APIs only
review.G-08: subprocess only for the audited decoder; frames via stdin; runner names prefixed
review.G-13: failed run raises with stderr tail; driver exceptions listed; unvalidated implementations excluded from comparisons
